name: langfuse
description: Skills for working with EvalFlow, the open-source LLM observability and evaluation platform for tracing, prompt management, and evaluation.

interface.shortDescription: Work with EvalFlow tracing, prompts, datasets, scores, and docs.
interface.longDescription: Reusable workflows for instrumenting applications, querying traces, managing prompts, running evaluations, and using Langfuse documentation from ChatGPT or Codex.
defaultPrompt: Set up Langfuse tracing in this app.
Inspect Langfuse traces for recent failures.

Upgrade this application's Langfuse SDKs and instrumentation, verify session and other correlating attributes on every applicable child observation, and prepare its Langfuse project for the v4 platform migration.
